description.content: Lists projects, optionally filtered by workspace and name.
Creates a project bound to a workspace and a source repository.
Updates a project (rename, or replace source binding).

Soft-deletes a project: removes it from normal reads and frees its name and source binding for reuse, but preserves eval-run and scenario-generation history. Who deleted it is recorded in the audit log.
Validates whether a locator/source pair maps to an existing project, surfacing drift or conflicts.
Admin-scoped API keys for support tooling.
